Please make me a playlist that takes me to Japan in 1500 BCE–2001 and lets me live there for a while, the way someone who grew up there remembers it. Play what people there actually heard back then, in the original recordings, all released by 2001: mostly songs by artists from there, in their own language (the radio hits, the dance and party favourites, the film songs, the evergreens everyone knew by heart), plus only the foreign hits that were genuinely big there at the time. Keep it at least two-thirds local. Start with the songs below, which were heard there then. They are only where the trip begins: play as many of them as feel right, then keep going and fill my whole stay with everything else that belongs there. Take me on as long a trip as you can, and don't bring me home early. Order everything so each song flows into the next and nothing jars.
